items.subject: Welcome to your Google Cloud Free Trial
items.summary: Google Cloud confirms that a free trial was started with $300 in promotional credit.
items.action: Confirm that you intentionally started the Google Cloud trial. If not, open Google Cloud Console and Google Account Security directly, review projects and billing, secure the account, and remove any unauthorised resources.
items.decisionNeeded: Confirm whether you intentionally started this Google Cloud trial.
